title: RepositoryShape
description: Schema for Repository entities following Open Pulse Ontology v2.0.0. Optimized for LLM agent parsing with descriptive guidance. ID hierarchy: githubRepositoryHandle → doi → uuid. SHACL requires: schema:name, pulse:githubRepositoryHandle, schema:author (min 1).

id.description: Resolved hierarchical identifier. Set to the first non-null value from: pulse:githubRepositoryHandle, schema:identifier (DOI), or uuid (fallback). Example: 'EPFL-ENAC/geodata-toolkit'

identifiers.description: All available identifiers for this repository. Contains pulse:githubRepositoryHandle, schema:identifier (DOI), and uuid

pulse:githubRepositoryHandle.description: GitHub repository handle. Format: owner/repo. Example: 'EPFL-ENAC/geodata-toolkit'

uuid.description: UUID4 fallback identifier. Always present. Example: 'b1c2d3e4-5f6a-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e'

idSource.description: Indicates which identifier was used as the primary 'id'. One of: 'pulse:githubRepositoryHandle', 'schema:identifier', or 'uuid'

schema:name.description: Repository display name. REQUIRED per SHACL. Example: 'Open Pulse Platform'

pulse:githubRepositoryHandle.description: GitHub repository handle. REQUIRED per SHACL. Format: owner/repo. Example: 'EPFL-ENAC/geodata-toolkit'

pulse:discipline.description: Array of Wikidata IRIs for disciplines. Format: wd:QXXXXX. Example: ['wd:Q21201', 'wd:Q8434']

schema:author.description: Array of PersonShape IDs (hierarchical). REQUIRED per SHACL (min 1 author). Example: ['0000-0001-2345-6789', 'mweber']

schema:dateCreated.description: Creation datetime in ISO 8601 format. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: '2023-03-15T10:30:00Z'

pulse:ownedBy.description: PersonShape or OrganizationShape ID (hierarchical) that owns this repository. Example: '95372c6b-7d45-432e-a84e-660c9fa54e05'

pulse:isForkOf.description: Parent RepositoryShape ID (GitHub handle) if this is a fork. Example: 'numpy/numpy'
